votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of December 9, 2025.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from the December 9, 2025 CRA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt CRA Resolution 8 of 2026, approving affordable housing priorities for the Fiscal Year 2026–27.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution establishing the FY2026-27 priorities for the Housing Development Funding Strategy, including deeply affordable housing, affordable family housing with amenities for children, wealth-building opportunities, expanding opportunities, and neighborhood services and commercial spaces.

votes.motion: Adopt CRA Resolution 9 of 2026, approving the Pickle & Hide Tax Increment Reimbursement Agreement term sheet modifications with the acknowledgment that the demolition and reconstruction of the Utah Pickle building modified the maximum property tax reimbursement amount to 90% and reduced the maximum reimbursement amount to $5,078,545, and included the Utah Renewable Community participation and new waiver as described in the motion sheet.
votes.description: The Board approved modifications to the Tax Increment Reimbursement Agreement with Mountain West Development, LLC for the Pickle & Hide development in the 900 South HTRZ, following the demolition of the Utah Pickle Co. building, adjusting the reimbursement terms accordingly.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Meeting for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and attorney-client matters.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed meeting to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open meeting.
